@microsoft/api-extractor.why: A nested override, `{ "minimatch": "^11.0.5" }`, clearing GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (minimatch <11.0.1) for api-extractor alone. api-extractor 7.60.1 (latest) pins minimatch at the exact 10.2.3, and its only call is `minimatch(dependencyName, pattern)` in `Collector.js`, which minimatch 11 keeps. Scoped rather than global because minimatch 11 drops `makeRe`, `matchOne` and the default export, which other consumers may still use.
@microsoft/api-extractor.manualCheck: Remove the override when api-extractor admits minimatch >=11.0.1, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and `npm run build`, which runs build:extract-api.

eslint-plugin-tsdoc.why: A nested override, `{ "minimatch": "^11.0.5" }`, clearing GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 for the copy under eslint-plugin-tsdoc alone. eslint-plugin-tsdoc 0.5.4 pins `@typescript-eslint/utils ~8.56.0`, whose typescript-estree 8.56.1 keeps minimatch 10 and calls only `minimatch(filePath, pattern, { dot: true })`, which minimatch 11 keeps.
eslint-plugin-tsdoc.manualCheck: Remove the override when eslint-plugin-tsdoc moves to a typescript-eslint that takes minimatch 11, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and `npm run lint`.

glob.why: Clears GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 (glob >=9.0.0 <=14.0.1, fixed in 14.0.2) and, with it, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 on the minimatch 10 that glob 13 nests. Only linkinator brings glob, and linkinator 8.1.0 (latest) still declares glob ^13.0.0. It calls only the async named `glob(pattern)` export, which glob 14 keeps. Replace glob itself rather than the minimatch under it: glob 10 and 13 read `Minimatch.set`, which minimatch 11 changes. Caret because it is an advisory floor.
glob.manualCheck: Remove the override when linkinator admits glob >=14.0.2, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and the Markdown gates.

katex.why: Clears GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7, fixed in KaTeX 0.18.2. micromark-extension-math 3.1.0 requires ^0.16.0, which excludes the fix; compatible audit updates cannot move it. Keep the first patched release exact because this crosses a 0.x minor boundary. Math HTML rendering and the Markdown gates were verified with this override.
katex.manualCheck: Remove the override when micromark-extension-math admits a patched KaTeX version, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and the Markdown gates.

obsidian.why: The release stream targets Obsidian 1.14.4. Keep the official API dependency exact so reconciliation and bundle checks use that version.
obsidian.manualCheck: Change this pin only when creating or reconciling a release stream for a different Obsidian version.

re2js.why: Clears GHSA-gg6h-894w-4m9c (RE2JS quadratic-time denial of service in lookbehind matching, >=2.2.0 <2.8.7). Reached only through markdownlint, whose newest release 0.42.0 pins re2js at the exact 2.8.6, and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 pins that markdownlint exactly in turn, so no bump reaches the fix. 2.9.1 is the version markdownlint itself moved to upstream, so the forced minor is the one it is tested against. NEVER take the `npm audit fix --force` remedy: it downgrades the toolkit packages.
re2js.manualCheck: The check reads the exact re2js pin of the installed markdownlint, which moves only when a markdownlint-cli2 release pins a newer markdownlint. When it reads 2.8.7 or later, drop the override and this entry and re-run `npm audit`.
